//! Unicode character data for the character and string procedures.
//!
//! Generated from the Unicode @@VERSION@@ database with
//! `tools/gen_unicode.py`; do not edit by hand. Property tables are inclusive
//! code point ranges. Case mappings are runs with a constant delta, stepping
//! by 1 or 2 (alphabets that alternate upper and lower case). Full mappings
//! that expand to several code points are listed separately.
const std = @import("std");

const Range = struct { lo: u21, hi: u21 };
const MapRun = struct { lo: u21, hi: u21, delta: i32, step: u8 };
const Special = struct { cp: u21, len: u8, to: [3]u21 };

fn inRanges(table: []const Range, cp: u21) bool {
    var lo: usize = 0;
    var hi: usize = table.len;
    while (lo < hi) {
        const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        const r = table[mid];
        if (cp < r.lo) {
            hi = mid;
        } else if (cp > r.hi) {
            lo = mid + 1;
        } else return true;
    }
    return false;
}

fn mapRun(table: []const MapRun, cp: u21) u21 {
    var lo: usize = 0;
    var hi: usize = table.len;
    while (lo < hi) {
        const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        const r = table[mid];
        if (cp < r.lo) {
            hi = mid;
        } else if (cp > r.hi) {
            lo = mid + 1;
        } else {
            if ((cp - r.lo) % r.step != 0) return cp;
            return @intCast(@as(i32, cp) + r.delta);
        }
    }
    return cp;
}

fn special(table: []const Special, cp: u21) ?[]const u21 {
    var lo: usize = 0;
    var hi: usize = table.len;
    while (lo < hi) {
        const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        const s = &table[mid];
        if (cp < s.cp) {
            hi = mid;
        } else if (cp > s.cp) {
            lo = mid + 1;
        } else return s.to[0..s.len];
    }
    return null;
}

pub fn isAlphabetic(cp: u21) bool {
    return inRanges(&alphabetic, cp);
}

pub fn isUpper(cp: u21) bool {
    return inRanges(&uppercase, cp);
}

pub fn isLower(cp: u21) bool {
    return inRanges(&lowercase, cp);
}

pub fn isWhitespace(cp: u21) bool {
    return inRanges(&whitespace, cp);
}

/// The value of a decimal digit character (Numeric_Type=Decimal), or null.
pub fn digitValue(cp: u21) ?u8 {
    var lo: usize = 0;
    var hi: usize = decimal_digits.len;
    while (lo < hi) {
        const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        const r = decimal_digits[mid];
        if (cp < r.lo) {
            hi = mid;
        } else if (cp > r.hi) {
            lo = mid + 1;
        } else return @intCast((cp - r.lo) % 10);
    }
    return null;
}

pub fn isNumeric(cp: u21) bool {
    return digitValue(cp) != null;
}

/// Simple (one to one) case mappings, for the character procedures.
pub fn toUpper(cp: u21) u21 {
    return mapRun(&simple_upper, cp);
}

pub fn toLower(cp: u21) u21 {
    return mapRun(&simple_lower, cp);
}

pub fn foldCase(cp: u21) u21 {
    return mapRun(&simple_fold, cp);
}

/// Full case mappings, for the string procedures: the result may hold up to
/// three code points. `buf` backs the single-code-point result.
pub fn fullUpper(cp: u21, buf: *[1]u21) []const u21 {
    if (special(&special_upper, cp)) |s| return s;
    buf[0] = toUpper(cp);
    return buf[0..1];
}

pub fn fullLower(cp: u21, buf: *[1]u21) []const u21 {
    if (special(&special_lower, cp)) |s| return s;
    buf[0] = toLower(cp);
    return buf[0..1];
}

pub fn fullFold(cp: u21, buf: *[1]u21) []const u21 {
    if (special(&special_fold, cp)) |s| return s;
    buf[0] = foldCase(cp);
    return buf[0..1];
}

const alphabetic = [_]Range{
@@ALPHA@@,
};

const uppercase = [_]Range{
@@UPPER@@,
};

const lowercase = [_]Range{
@@LOWER@@,
};

const whitespace = [_]Range{
@@SPACE@@,
};

const decimal_digits = [_]Range{
@@DIGITS@@,
};

const simple_upper = [_]MapRun{
@@RUP@@,
};

const simple_lower = [_]MapRun{
@@RLO@@,
};

const simple_fold = [_]MapRun{
@@RFO@@,
};

const special_upper = [_]Special{
@@SPU@@,
};

const special_lower = [_]Special{
@@SPL@@,
};

const special_fold = [_]Special{
@@SPF@@,
};

test "case mapping samples" {
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(u21, 'A'), toUpper('a'));
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(u21, 0x39B), toUpper(0x3BB)); // lambda
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(u21, 0x3C3), foldCase(0x3C2)); // final sigma folds to sigma
    try std.testing.expect(isAlphabetic(0x39B));
    try std.testing.expect(isWhitespace(0x3000));
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(?u8, 4), digitValue(0x664));
    var buf: [1]u21 = undefined;
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(usize, 2), fullUpper(0xDF, &buf).len); // sharp s -> SS
}
